classification.difficultyReason: Infer the second 8 cm side from equal base angles, calculate the 80° included angle, and substitute into the triangle area rule.

content.prompt: Find the area of $\triangle ABC$, correct to 2 decimal places.

spec.description: Triangle ABC with A above horizontal BC, outside vertex labels, AB labelled 8 cm and both base angles labelled 50 degrees. No equality ticks or solution values added.
spec.mathematics: Angle B equals angle C equals 50 degrees; AB is 8 cm.

answer.worked:
Equal angles at $B$ and $C$ give $AC=AB=8\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}\angle BAC&=180^\circ-50^\circ-50^\circ\\\angle BAC&=80^\circ.\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\text{Area}&=\frac12\times8\times8\times\sin80^\circ\\\text{Area}&=32\sin80^\circ\\\text{Area}&\approx31.51\text{ cm}^2.\end{align*}$$
